RI-PRICE-INV.title: Price scoring inversion: near-EQ (r1=1-10) outperforms deep-discount (r1=21-30)
RI-PRICE-INV.finding: Current linear scoring rewards the wrong range. delta_r20d when r1>0: +0.59%.
RI-PRICE-INV.next_required_action: Test modified buy-zone scoring in shadow mode; cross-check WF fold consistency.

RI-OB-HARM.title: Order Block presence REDUCES expected return by -1.4%
RI-OB-HARM.finding: r2_ob>0 signals underperform (delta_r20d=-1.4%). 3 modules agree, but WF folds inconsistent — System Audit verdict: OVERFITTED.
RI-OB-HARM.next_required_action: Extend OOS window to 6+ months. Do not remove OB until WF folds converge.

RI-HTF-INV.title: HTF Scoring Inversion: HH+HL = -0.8%, HL-only = +11.6%
RI-HTF-INV.finding: Full HH+HL confirmation currently scores highest but returns -0.8%. HL-only returns +11.6%. System Audit WF-consistent.
RI-HTF-INV.next_required_action: Implement HTF scoring inversion fix in shadow mode for 20 sessions.

RI-DEM-PAR.title: Demand Zone Paradox: SV+HVN (max score=15) = lowest return
RI-DEM-PAR.finding: SV+HVN together is the worst demand outcome. HVN-only is the best. The scoring function is rewarding the wrong combination.
RI-DEM-PAR.next_required_action: Validate HVN-only vs SV+HVN split across WF folds. Fix internal scoring multipliers in sc_demand().

RI-LIQ-WICK.title: Rejection Wick (r3=8 pts) has near-zero edge — sub-component overweighted
RI-LIQ-WICK.finding: Wick rejection is the weakest liquidity sub-signal. Reducing its multiplier from 0.6 to 0.15 frees weight for equal-lows.
RI-LIQ-WICK.next_required_action: Cross-validate wick reduction in Weight Optimizer and Walk-Forward before changing.

RI-DIV-RSI.title: RSI Divergence: NEGATIVE edge (mean=3.8% vs baseline 4.7%)
RI-DIV-RSI.finding: rsi_div=1 signals underperform. r7_div combines RSI+MACD div — RSI drag cancels MACD edge. Need to separate them.
RI-DIV-RSI.next_required_action: Separate RSI and MACD divergence sub-scores in sc_div(). RSI div should be zeroed or penalized.

RI-MACD-REDUCE.title: r6_macd: reduce 4 → 2  (Optimizer=1.2, RL=1.1, WF=2.9 — 3-method convergence)
RI-MACD-REDUCE.finding: Three independent methods converge on reducing r6_macd. Only weight change currently with HIGH evidence.
RI-MACD-REDUCE.next_required_action: Stage shadow scoring with r6_macd=2 for 20 trading sessions. This is the only weight change currently safe to promote.

RI-AVWAP-REDUCE.title: r5_avwap: reduce 8 → 4-6  (Optimizer=4.3, RL=4.1, WF=6.3 — 3-method convergence)
RI-AVWAP-REDUCE.finding: Three methods agree: reduce AVWAP weight. Positive delta when present but modest. Consensus around 4-6.
RI-AVWAP-REDUCE.next_required_action: Shadow test r5_avwap=5 for 20 sessions. Validate after r6_macd reduction is complete (one change at a time).

RI-GATE-LIQ20.title: Liquidity gate: r3_liquidity >= 20  (optimizer confidence=0.88 — highest of all gates)
RI-GATE-LIQ20.finding: Retains 43% of signals, win_rate=68.4%, expected return +0.9% vs baseline. Highest optimizer confidence.
RI-GATE-LIQ20.next_required_action: Validate across WF fold periods. If consistent, stage for shadow scoring.

RI-GATE-SCORE.title: Score gates (>=55, >=60) — REJECTED: OVERFITTED in System Audit OOS
RI-GATE-SCORE.finding: Score gate >=55: IS +1.75% but OOS -4.52%. Gate >=60: IS +1.06%, OOS OVERFITTED. Both confirmed overfitted.
RI-GATE-SCORE.next_required_action: Rejected. Score-based gates on raw_score are overfitted. Do not reopen without new architecture.

RI-OPT-REBAL.title: Full weight rebalance (Optimizer) — OOS improvement ≈ 0, high overfit risk
RI-OPT-REBAL.finding: ML rebalance to Liq=28, Div=26, Demand=21, Price=12. OOS improvement=-0.000039 ≈ zero. Conflicts with RL and WF.
RI-OPT-REBAL.next_required_action: Do not promote as a batch. Decompose into per-indicator items. Validate each independently.

RI-SWEEP-GATE.title: Sweep detected mandatory gate — System Audit: CONFIRMED
RI-SWEEP-GATE.finding: sweep=1 signals: IS diff=+0.013, OOS=+0.077, WF consistent=True. Folds=[0.0523, -0.0069, 0.0126, 0.0789].
RI-SWEEP-GATE.next_required_action: Reduces signals by 54.6%. Shadow test 20 sessions to measure opportunity cost before promoting.

RI-HVN-CONF.title: HVN-only = strongest demand signal — System Audit: CONFIRMED
RI-HVN-CONF.finding: HVN hit outperforms. WF consistent=True, OOS diff=+0.090. Folds=[0.0243, -0.0126, 0.0062, 0.0913].
RI-HVN-CONF.next_required_action: Promote HVN-only scoring fix: increase HVN-only sub-score, decrease SV+HVN sub-score in sc_demand().

RI-ARCH-ADDITIVE.title: Additive scoring: OOS R² = -0.15 — architecture cannot be fixed by weight tuning
RI-ARCH-ADDITIVE.finding: Current additive weighted sum has OOS R²=-0.15 (negative!). Architecture is not predicting returns. Recommendation: mandatory gate (sweep=1 + r1≥gate) × quality bonus. Non-linear with minimum viable conditions outperforms additive sum.
RI-ARCH-ADDITIVE.next_required_action: Design non-linear scoring: mandatory gates × quality bonus. Test vs current additive sum. This is the root cause of the learning plateau.

RI-HTF-FIX-IMPACT.title: HTF inversion fix = highest single-change impact per System Audit
RI-HTF-FIX-IMPACT.finding: Fix HTF scoring inversion: HH+HL currently scores highest but returns -0.8%. HL-only returns +11.6%. A single logic fix (swap full/partial scoring) could shift system performance significantly.
RI-HTF-FIX-IMPACT.next_required_action: Swap HH+HL → 0 pts, HL-only → full pts in sc_htf(). Shadow mode 20 sessions.

evidence_data.note: Fix HTF scoring inversion: HH+HL currently scores highest but returns -0.8%. HL-only returns +11.6%. A single logic fix (swap full/partial scoring) could shift system performance significantly.

RI-HVN-HTF-BONUS.title: IMP-5: HVN + HTF_HH super-bonus tier — model_score=100, n=8.5% of signals
RI-HVN-HTF-BONUS.finding: delta_ret=+0.026 when hvn_hit=1 AND htf_hh=1. WF-consistent=True. Only 8.5% of signals qualify. GX memory flags as overfitted.
RI-HVN-HTF-BONUS.next_required_action: Need 6+ months forward data (n≥150) before promoting. Do not apply to main scanner.

RI-RL-NEG-DISC.title: SMC RL discrimination = -4.23 (NEGATIVE — top-quartile underperforms bottom)
RI-RL-NEG-DISC.finding: After 40 epochs on 395 signals: top-Q avg=17.26% vs bot-Q avg=21.48%. Loss=0.2386 converging but model is inversely predictive.
RI-RL-NEG-DISC.next_required_action: Diagnose RL objective function. Likely the target variable is inverted or the loss is minimizing the wrong direction. Do not use RL weights for any promotion until fixed.

RI-WF-DRIFT.title: Walk-Forward: 194 weight updates but max drift 28% — micro-corrections only
RI-WF-DRIFT.finding: 865 trades, equity grew to 2427x. But weights barely moved from original (max drift 27.7%). WF is not encoding structural fixes (HTF inversion, OB removal).
RI-WF-DRIFT.next_required_action: Evaluate whether WF's trade-by-trade micro-learning can coexist with structural overrides. May need a 'structural anchor' layer above WF.

RI-MICRO-FEATURES.title: Edge Discovery: 30 microstructure features predict returns but are absent from scanner
RI-MICRO-FEATURES.finding: 8085 significant rules found. Top features: snap_reclaim_spd, feat_dist_52w_low, feat_dist_last_bos, snap_atr. Best rule achieves WR=100% on n=15.
RI-MICRO-FEATURES.next_required_action: Start with snap_reclaim_spd (reclaim speed appears in multiple top rules). Research whether it can be computed daily and added as r9 without major architecture change.

RI-QUANT-R2.title: All ML models R² ≤ -0.012 — scoring has zero predictive power for returns
RI-QUANT-R2.finding: RF R²=-1.225, GBM R²=-0.021, XGBoost R²=-0.012. AUC=0.506 (near random). High-confidence prob model hits 72% precision but only on tiny subset.
RI-QUANT-R2.next_required_action: Confirms RI-ARCH-ADDITIVE. Weight tuning cannot fix R²<0. Structural redesign needed — not weight changes.

RI-DIV-MACD.title: MACD Divergence: PF=3.82 vs baseline 2.50 — strongest edge of any flag
RI-DIV-MACD.finding: macd_div=1: n=74, PF=3.82, WR=44.6%, mean=0.060. RSI div is negative — must be separated before increasing r7_div.
RI-DIV-MACD.next_required_action: Separate RSI and MACD div sub-scores in sc_div() first (RI-DIV-RSI). Then test r7_div increase from 3 → 5.

RI-SYS-PROMOTE.title: Structural gap: no promotion pipeline — all 33 findings stuck at Proposed, actual_delta=None
RI-SYS-PROMOTE.finding: The learning ecosystem has no mechanism to move findings from Proposed → Staged → Promoted. actual_delta_ret=None for every recommendation. The system discovers but does not learn.
RI-SYS-PROMOTE.next_required_action: Implement shadow scoring: run scanner in parallel with proposed change, log results without alerting, compare after 20 sessions. This is the single highest-ROI engineering task.

RI-SYS-WFSCOPE.title: Walk-Forward micro-learning cannot encode structural fixes — two incompatible learning speeds
RI-SYS-WFSCOPE.finding: WF adjusts weights ±0.05 per trade. Structural fixes (HTF inversion, OB removal) require ±5-10 point changes. These cannot coexist in the same update loop.
RI-SYS-WFSCOPE.next_required_action: Design two-layer weight system: structural base (updated quarterly via promotion) + WF micro-delta (updated per trade).
